legal.terms.title: Terms of use
legal.terms.intro: These terms govern access to Ment, a platform for arranging knowledge-sharing conversations between members of participating organizations.
legal.terms.1.title: Your account
legal.terms.1.body: Use accurate profile information, protect your login credentials, and notify your organization if you believe your account has been compromised.
legal.terms.2.title: Acceptable use
legal.terms.2.body: Use Ment to make relevant professional or educational connections. Do not scrape profiles, impersonate another person, harass members, or upload material you do not have permission to share.
legal.terms.3.title: Sessions and messages
legal.terms.3.body: Members decide whether to accept a request. Ment does not guarantee a match, response, meeting, employment outcome, or professional advice.
legal.terms.4.title: Organization access
legal.terms.4.body: Your organization controls membership and may manage account access. Private reflections and ratings are not exposed to other members through the product.
legal.terms.5.title: Service changes
legal.terms.5.body: Features may change as the product develops. Material changes to these terms will be communicated through the service or the account contact.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy notice
legal.privacy.intro: This notice explains what personal data Ment uses, why, who it is shared with and the choices you have. Ment connects students and alumni of participating universities and organisations for short conversations. In this notice, "Ment", "we" and "us" mean the team that runs Ment.
legal.privacy.1.title: Who is responsible
legal.privacy.1.body: If you joined through your university or organisation, it decides who is invited and Ment runs the service for it. The agreement between them sets out each side's responsibilities, and you can contact either about your data. For this website and for access requests, Ment is responsible.
legal.privacy.2.title: What we collect
legal.privacy.2.body: Your account: name, email address, sign-in details, and the organisation, programme and year you belong to. Your profile: what you add or import, such as headline, experience, education, skills, languages, city and LinkedIn link, plus your availability and meeting limits. Your activity: searches in the chat, requests, messages, meeting times and links, and any feedback, reflections or ratings you choose to give. Optional: a CV you upload and calendar accounts you connect. On the website: the name, email address, organisation and note you send when you request access.
legal.privacy.3.title: Why we use it
legal.privacy.3.body: To run your account and profile; to suggest relevant people and explain why they fit; to handle requests, messages and meetings and send you emails about them; to keep the platform secure and prevent misuse; and to give your organisation aggregate reports on activity. We use access requests only to reply to them. We do not sell personal data or use it for advertising.
legal.privacy.4.title: AI-assisted features
legal.privacy.4.body: Ment uses Mistral AI to understand searches, suggest people, draft a profile from a CV, draft a first message and pick out skills from a reflection. When the AI suggests people, their names are replaced before anything is sent; text you write and a CV you upload are sent as you provide them. You choose who to contact, and you review profile and message drafts before they are saved or sent. AI is never used for admissions, grading, hiring or any other decision about you. You can switch AI features off in your profile at any time, and you then no longer appear in AI suggestions.
legal.privacy.5.title: Who can see what
legal.privacy.5.body: Other members of your network see your profile as your organisation's settings allow. Your LinkedIn link is shown only to people you have connected or met with. Messages are visible to the people in the conversation. Reflections and ratings stay private to you. Your organisation's administrators can manage accounts and see aggregate reports, which never show named people and combine small groups.
legal.privacy.6.title: Service providers
legal.privacy.6.body: Supabase (accounts, database and file storage), Vercel (website hosting), Mistral AI (AI features), Resend (service emails), and Google or Microsoft only if you connect a calendar. When you search for a skill, the words you type are sent to the European Commission's public ESCO skills service. Providers use data only to run their part of the service. If any of them processes data outside the European Economic Area, this happens only with the safeguards the GDPR requires.
legal.privacy.7.title: How long we keep it
legal.privacy.7.body: We keep your data while your account is active. Text extracted from an uploaded CV is deleted after 30 days, and withdrawing CV permission deletes your CV files and drafts. When an account is deleted, its data is erased and the other person in a conversation sees only a former member. Other retention periods are agreed with your organisation. Copies in backups are removed when those backups expire.
legal.privacy.8.title: Your rights
legal.privacy.8.body: In your profile you can correct your details, download your data, switch AI off, withdraw CV permission and delete your account. You can also ask to access, correct, restrict or erase your data, or object to how it is used, by writing to privacy@ment-labs.com. We reply within one month. You can complain to the data protection authority where you live or work, such as the Garante in Italy or the CNIL in France.
legal.privacy.9.title: Cookies and browser storage
legal.privacy.9.body: Ment uses no advertising or analytics cookies. Your browser stores only what the site needs to work: your sign-in session, your chosen language, and a one-time marker used when the site updates. None of this is used to track you.
legal.privacy.10.title: Contact and changes
legal.privacy.10.body: Write to privacy@ment-labs.com with any question about this notice or your data. If we change this notice in a way that matters, we will tell you in Ment and ask you to review it again.
